about: What Cable Club can do in each game (point 1d of the evolution plan). Read by the server (slt.server.Capabilities) and by the interface (web/js/data/capabilities.js): one source for both. A generation gives the defaults, a game may change them. A rule or a mode lists the capabilities it needs; without one of them it is not offered for that game (the server refuses to turn the rule on, or to create the room).
